character: An old tengu woman, a crow-headed person, black feathers with a faint grey salt-tarnish, small rings along her beak. Flat black eyes looking down at the viewer, beak closed, perfectly still. One hand raised, fingers mid-count.
wardrobe: A heavy, weathered dark naval captain's coat, wide turned-back cuffs and lapels, flared skirts to the knee. Every button a different precious metal, gold, silver, copper, brass, each polished bright and gleaming against the worn cloth. Rings on every finger, talons in ship-leather boots.

full.framing: Full body portrait, seen slightly from below. Standing tall and very still in a long dark corridor of numbered iron vault doors, a dim red glow rising from below, ember light on the floor and the hem of her coat, cold light from above.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, seen slightly from below, eyes looking down at the viewer, a dim red glow rising from below onto her beak and collar, cold light from above.

scene.framing: Standing at the far end of a long narrow corridor of numbered locked iron doors in a tall dark vault-tower, one door open beside her on a bare stone room holding a single ledger on a stand, a dim red glow rising from below, ember light on the floor, cold light from above.
